body.label: Effect
body.html: Create a 1-unit stone barrier in an empty space within 4 units. It grants cover and lasts until your next turn.

surges.html: Create a small persistent magical object or patch of terrain appropriate to this spell until the start of your next turn.
Change one affected surface or object to a temporary material state appropriate to the spell until your next turn.

rider.title: EARTH THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread when you create terrain, a barrier, or an object to extend its duration through the end of your next turn.
